title: Identity law for normalized rational left coefficient comparisons
statement: For every compactification c, finite stage E and K in the rational E category, the rational identity comparison followed by the operation map of sfRationalScalarUnit equals the sfRationalScalarUnit component at the operation image.

source.place: The construction paragraph of the constructible exceptional adjunction blueprint; this is the normalized coefficient construction split from the assembly theorem.

proof.text: For a rational input choose its unchanged integral representative in the finite-Tor subcategory, using integral_residue_tor and invertibility of l on X.

Apply the proved restricted ring identity to R.comparison and R.scalarIdentity for the completed identity field embedding. Both scalar and compact-support realizations are exactly those carried by R. Apply rationalization to this equality and use map_comp.

Apply normalized_integral_scalar_unit at both endpoints, using R.integralScalar_eq, R.integralScalar_normalized and the recorded scalar identity. This bridge uses the underlying integral normalization comparison, lifts it through the faithful intrinsic inclusion and applies raw localization. The component characterization of sfRationalScalarUnit identifies the resulting localized units.

R.integralScalar_eq and sfRationalScalarExtension_obj identify the scalar objects. F.rational_normalized identifies q with the localized integral q, F.rationalAction identifies the rational operation on the localized unit arrow, and its object clause identifies the output. Transport the equality from step 2 along these component equalities; heterogeneous equality handles the specified object presentations. No faithfulness or general linearity of the rational operation is used.

proof_origin.place: Identity component: the restricted ring identity, integral unit normalization, scalar-object transport and forward raw localization.

from.place: The composition and identity components of the normalized rational left laws.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_rational_left_identity (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R) :
    ∀ (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l)
      (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.rational E)),
      (F.rationalComparison c E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier)).q.hom.app K ≫
        (R.operation c (.rational E)).F.map
          ((sfRationalScalarUnit l E.carrier X 0
            (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero).hom.app K) =
      (sfRationalScalarUnit l E.carrier Y 0 (Fact.out : l.Prime).ne_zero).hom.app
        ((R.operation c (.rational E)).F.obj K)
